run_eval_lightning: run the eval_lightning module to evaluate a model on test and valid subsets using Hydra config
test_model_with_lightning_trainer: test a loaded model on test and valid data loaders using PyTorch Lightning Trainer
load_model_from_path: load a model, scene, and config from a model checkpoint path using load_from_model_path
evaluate_gaussian_grouping_model: evaluate a GaussianGrouping model by loading its checkpoint and running tests on data subsets
save_eval_logs_to_csv: save model evaluation logs from test_logs to a CSV file after running trainer.test
